title: Intake ORBIT: cost calculator and routing playbook for composite usage asks
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Summary: Build an intake playbook (codename ORBIT) and lightweight UI components to triage composite usage/export requests from customers: provide a fast cost estimate, map request to an implementation lane, and surface a tenant-aware preview and compliance gating. ORBIT stands for Outcome, Resource, Budget, Ingress, Timeline.

Goals: 
- Reduce time-to-decision for inbound reporting and usage analytics asks from >48h to <8h by providing structured metadata capture and automated routing suggestions.
- Surface estimated token/compute cost and queue impact to customers and CS before manual engineering work is scheduled.
- Provide clear lanes (self-serve export template, scheduled tenant snapshot, concierge one-off) and automated rules for routing to Console, Solutions, or Eng.

Scope: 
In scope: intake form enhancements, cost estimator service prototype, routing/playbook rules, tenant permissions check, interactive sample preview in Console, and playbook documentation for Solutions/CS.
Out of scope: full export execution engine, new billing primitives, or heavy-weight per-tenant ETL connectors (these are follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: Interactive intake form implemented in Console that collects ORBIT fields; required fields validated.
Client-facing cost estimator returns a 90th percentile cost estimate with confidence band and shows dominant cost drivers.
Automated routing matrix that suggests one of three lanes (self-serve template, scheduled snapshot, concierge) with rationale shown.
Tenant permission and data-sensitivity gating: UI flags when request requires enterprise approval or security review.
Sample-preview generation: quick 10-row CSV/JSON preview generated from a sanitized sample query within 5 minutes of intake.
Playbook doc created and linked to Solutions and CS runbooks; includes SLA expectations for each lane and escalation paths.
Metrics emitted: intake-to-decision latency, %auto-routed, average estimated cost, false-positive routing rate below 10%.
Design review signoff and PM + Eng alignment on API contract for cost estimator and routing rules.
Legal/compliance signoff if a request is flagged as high-sensitivity; otherwise security_review_required remains false.
Rollout plan with feature flag and pilot with 3 mid-market customers completed before GA.
comments: 2026-02-20 Priya Nair: Initial intake — capture ORBIT concept and high-level goals. Requesting alignment with Eng on feasibility for sample preview.

2026-02-25 Diego Alvarez: Scoped prototype for cost estimator; will reuse existing telemetry tokenization service and add sampling layer. Blocking: need schema for tenant data sensitivity flags from Security.
2026-03-01 Aisha Raman: Solutions flagged two high-touch customers to pilot; added example exports that must be supported (hourly usage, per-route cost breakdown, per-model token breakdown).
2026-03-05 Eng sync: Agreed to provide an endpoint returning cost estimate and sequence-length distribution sample; estimate accuracy target set to +/- 30% for prototype.
decision_log: Use a three-tier routing lane (self-serve, scheduled snapshot, concierge) rather than a continuous scoring system to simplify CS handoffs.
Cost estimator will operate in two modes: fast heuristic (for UI latency <1s) and deep sample (background job within 5 mins) for higher accuracy.
Sample previews will be sanitized by removing PII fields using the existing Redact service; Security to provide redaction rules.
Expose routing rationale to CS/Eng in intake detail to reduce back-and-forth and enable faster acceptance/decline decisions.
stakeholders: Marcus Liu - Eng Lead, Console UX
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (pilot): Implement intake form + fast cost heuristic + routing suggestion behind feature flag; pilot with 3 mid-market tenants.
Phase 2 (preview): Add background deep-sample estimator and sample-preview generation; extend pilot to 12 tenants and collect routing feedback.
Phase 3 (GA): Enable self-serve lane and SLA commitments; publish playbook for Solutions/CS and add Console telemetry dashboard for intake metrics.
Post-GA: Iterate on cost model accuracy and add templated export connectors as high-value follow-ups.
